novelty_flags.one_line: The survey omits Jin, Mackey, and Syrgkanis (NeurIPS 2025), the closest PLM structure-agnostic minimax paper; distinguish its binary-treatment and Gaussian-noise frontiers from the bounded continuous-treatment common-code regime.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Appendix A.1, pp. 18–19, equations (A.1)–(A.2) and Theorem A.1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines m as sup over class pairs F_mu,F_pi, then inf over estimators, then sup over P in its specified P(F_mu,F_pi); (A.1) additionally fixes its PLM family and conditional residual-variance condition. Theorem A.1 gives the stated upper minimum and lower expression.
The note states that structure-agnostic PLM optimality remains open and identifies the role of variance as the gap not addressed by earlier lower bounds.

The paper proves a PLM-restricted lower bound for expected conditional covariance using PLM-preserving invariant perturbations, and explicitly distinguishes that functional from a PLM-coefficient lower bound.
The paper develops a structure-agnostic minimax framework for canonical functional-estimation problems, including expected conditional covariance.
The published article presents partially linear regression with a treatment regression and develops cross-fitted DML for its coefficient.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Redefine the flagship comparison on Gu et al.'s exact fixed-class experiment, including its P(F_mu,F_pi) restrictions and quantifier order; prove that a single fixed code pair represents the selected hard classes before claiming a lower bound for Gu's m.

Add Jin--Mackey--Syrgkanis (2025) and state a precise non-overlap: bounded continuous treatment, localized-critical-radius class budgets, and observed-code all-estimator risk versus their binary/Gaussian noise regimes.
Add a second open kernel for a uniformly attaining estimator if the product converse fails, or state a formal dichotomy theorem whose two branches are both on the same experiment as Gu et al.

recommended_next_step: Revise the comparator experiment and incorporate the NeurIPS 2025 PLM frontier before sending this angle to Stage 0.
